text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Each sprint focuses on completing a small part of the project. Every day, team members hold quick meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. Tasks are kept in a list known as the backlog, and they are often described as user stories, which explain what a user needs. This iterative development approach helps teams improve their product step by step and respond quickly to changes.
